description: This file defines a utility class 'Log' for centralized logging, providing methods to log messages at various levels (VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, ASSERT) and manage logging nodes in an Android application.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A helper class that provides static methods for logging messages at different levels and managing log nodes in Android applications.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the logging chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode to which log data will be sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Sends a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable to the log chain.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a verbose message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a debug message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs an info message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a warning message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs an error message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs an assertion (fatal) message with optional Throwable.
